name: RenameMailFolder
description: Renames an existing mail folder in a specified mailbox using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox containing the folder to rename.

fields.name: FolderName
fields.label: Current Folder Name
fields.description: The existing display name of the folder.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.label: New Folder Name
fields.description: The new display name for the folder.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the folder rename operation, including success status and any error messages.
